what: Went live January 2024 on SAP S/4HANA for 70,000 users in nine months, consolidating SAP and non-SAP ERP data, on time with minimal disruption.
Big-bang go-live of OneERP on S/4HANA (RISE) replaced 9 plant systems and migrated over 550 million data records while keeping operations running.
Selective Bluefield move to S/4HANA finished in 10 months; the system cut over in 20 hours over Easter 2025 with no production downtime.
Greenfield S/4HANA went live 4 August 2025 for Civitanavi Systems in seven months, in scope and on schedule, with 150+ team members.
Migrated ECC to S/4HANA in under 12 months, on schedule, with a single-weekend cutover across 100+ plants, 40+ countries and 6,000+ users.
Simultaneous S/4HANA and Transportation Management go-live at all German and French sites on schedule; cutover window about 100 hours, 600+ activities.
Built the SE Data Center on Snowflake with SAP data replicated every 20 minutes; its Procurement Cockpit spans 20+ factories and saves over 150,000 hours a year.
Migrating a sprawling SAP estate (R/3 4.6, ECC 6.0) to S/4HANA, returning to standard after heavy ABAP customisation; finance, materials and parts of Helicopters are done, bulk remains.
Moving a single global SAP instance with 300,000+ custom objects to S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, splitting it into several business-related instances; announced May 2025, not complete.
